text:
sre-oncall: Alert: auth edge in ap-southeast-1 showing spike in 504s and token issuance timeouts since 02:15 SGT. Creating thread for timeline and mitigation. /cc @channel

ops-bot: [ALERT] edge-auth-proxy 504-rate > 4% (ap-southeast-1)

julia: Seeing repeated upstream resets to token-service and connection pool exhaust logs. Capturing pod logs now.

kevin: I rolled back auth-service v2.15.0 canary at 02:22 SGT to v2.14.9 in the region. Starting scale-up for token-service replicas by 3.

lia: Customer impact: Redwood Private tenants with regional KMS saw auth failures for short-lived tokens. Hosted users unaffected. Support queue: 9 customers flagged.

platform-eng: Mitigation steps executed: 1) rollback complete, 2) token-service replicas +3, 3) client retry jitter enabled to reduce synchronized retries. Early metrics: request success up ~60%.

sre-oncall: Initial hypothesis: a TLS/ALPN change in v2.15.0 causes SSL session renegotiations that exhaust the connection pool under load. Reproducing in staging.

julia: Logs excerpt: 
```
2026-03-22T02:17:39+08:00 WARN proxy: tls renegotiate detected, session_id=abc123
2026-03-22T02:18:02+08:00 ERROR auth: conn_pool: waiters=210, max_conns=200
2026-03-22T02:19:11+08:00 INFO deploy: rollback auth-service:v2.14.9
```

kevin: Follow-ups: revert ALPN change in client handshake, add connection pool metrics (waiters, leased), and add a chaos preflight that simulates SSL session churn.

support: Drafted customer message: "We detected transient token timeouts in ap-southeast-1 starting 02:15 SGT. We rolled back a recent auth service change and applied mitigations. If you continue to see timeouts, please reply and we'll prioritize."

lia: I'll send the notice to affected Private customers and tag for priority CS response.

platform-eng: Current status: mitigated. 504s dropped from ~4.3% -> 0.7% in 20m. Queue for token requests draining, expected to normalize in 30-45m.

sre-oncall: ETA to normal: ~30-45 minutes. Postmortem owner: @kevin - please lead RCA and remediation actions.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll open the incident doc with timeline, config diff, and remediation tasks. Target postmortem: within 48 hours.

ops-bot: [RESOURCES] Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/auth-proxy.md | Incident board: https://status.redwood.infra/incidents/1724000000 (internal preview)

sre-oncall: Thanks all. If anyone sees regression, ping pager immediately. We will close thread when token error rate <0.5% for 15m.
